question: Is Gemini on the shared pipeline no worse than the one-prompt Gemini brain, on the same days?
change: Round 4, the model held fixed: Gemini on the understand, decide and act, say pipeline (brain 'pipeline'), after round 3's Python-owned failures were fixed as scenario tests, against the one-prompt Gemini brain ('frontier'), both run fresh at the same commit
why: The pipeline replaces the one-prompt brain only if it's no worse; run once with --brain frontier, then with --brain pipeline, and compare the catalogues.

scenarios.why: work, errands and changes of plan in one day
beats: 09:05 Tell the app the icon concepts must be done before the 4:00 call, and only between 10 and 3.
16:45 Report the icon concepts and the call as done in one short message ("both done").

scenarios.why: many small requests, several at once
beats: 06:35 Say work only fits between 9 and 2:30 while the kids are at school, and ask for your three work tasks inside it.
14:20 Say "all of those are done" about the work tasks.

scenarios.why: something runs late and the day has to move
beats: 12:35 Say lunch is just a sandwich, ten minutes.
13:50 Report two errands as done with "both happened earlier".

scenarios.why: a low-energy day: fewer, shorter messages
beats: 09:20 Ask for at least an hour of rest between anything that makes you stand up.
19:00 Say "everything is done, I am exhausted, going to bed".

scenarios.why: a first day with the app
beats: 10:00 Ask to rename one of your items and to move another to a different list, in plain words.
20:30 Report two things done using shorthand for their names.

bar: Written before either round 4 run started, nothing of either seen. The pipeline is no worse if, on the same 5 days: no friction kind appears that the one-prompt run doesn't have; every friction kind is on at most one more day than with the one-prompt brain; the total of days with any friction is at most one more, and frictions per day are no higher on average; no internal text reaches the person; done items recorded are within 2 of the one-prompt run's; the Joplin checks stay clean (nothing written into a routine, no line twice, nothing done left open); median trust at bed is no more than 1 lower; and the unit tests are green at the run's commit. Failing any one parks the pipeline design.
